title: Creamy Corn Pasta
description: Quick pasta coated in a creamy corn sauce with Parmesan.
substitutions: Use frozen or canned drained corn.
Use half-and-half for a richer sauce.

steps.text: Cook pasta until tender; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Melt butter in a skillet. Add corn and cook 3 minutes.
Add milk and Parmesan, then toss in pasta. Add a splash of reserved water until creamy.

cookSteps.text: Cook 8 ounces pasta until tender. Before draining, save 1/2 cup pasta water.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet. Add 2 cups corn and cook 3 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup milk and 1/2 cup Parmesan. Toss in the drained pasta and add a splash of pasta water until creamy. Finish with 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat with a splash of milk.

title: Lemony Chickpea Couscous
description: A bright pantry meal with fluffy couscous, chickpeas, lemon, and herbs.
substitutions: Use white beans instead of chickpeas.
Use bottled lemon juice in a pinch.

steps.text: Bring water or broth to a boil. Stir in couscous, cover, remove from heat, and rest 5 minutes.
Fluff couscous and stir in chickpeas, lemon juice, olive oil, and herbs.
Taste and season with salt and pepper.

cookSteps.text: Bring 1 cup water or broth to a boil. Stir in 1 cup couscous, cover, remove from heat, and rest 5 minutes.
Fluff the couscous and stir in 1 can chickpeas, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tablespoons olive oil, and 2 tablespoons herbs if using.
Taste and season with salt and pepper.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Good cold or reheated.

title: Sheet-Pan Maple Mustard Carrots & Chickpeas
description: Sweet-savory roasted carrots and chickpeas that make an easy vegetarian dinner or side.
substitutions: Use honey instead of maple syrup.

steps.text: Toss carrots and chickpeas with maple syrup, mustard, oil, and salt.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until carrots are tender and chickpeas are browned.

cookSteps.text: Toss 1 pound sliced carrots and 1 can chickpeas with 1 1/2 tablespoons maple syrup, 1 1/2 tablespoons mustard, 1 tablespoon oil, and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast 25–30 minutes, stirring once, until the carrots are tender and the chickpeas are browned.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven, air fryer, or microwave.

title: Cabbage & White Bean Skillet
description: Tender cabbage and creamy white beans in a simple garlicky skillet.
substitutions: Use chickpeas instead of white beans.
Use bagged coleslaw mix for the cabbage.

steps.text: Heat oil or butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add cabbage and cook 8 minutes.
Add garlic, white beans, and broth. Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Uncover, cook until most liquid is gone, and finish with lemon juice if using.

cookSteps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons oil or butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1/2 head thinly sliced cabbage and cook 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 can white beans, and 1/2 cup broth or water. Cover and cook 5 minutes.
Uncover and cook until most liquid is gone. Finish with 1 tablespoon lemon juice if using.
